title: BCCWJ-MEG
description: BCCWJ-MEG contains magnetoencephalography recordings from 35 right-handed native Japanese speakers who read Japanese newspaper articles word by word using rapid serial visual presentation. It is part of the BCCWJ-Brain collection, which also includes fMRI and EEG datasets acquired from separate participant groups with the same stimuli, enabling cross-modality comparison of language processing. Raw data, T1-weighted anatomical images, and preprocessed derivatives are provided.
methods_description: Continuous MEG was recorded with a 200-channel axial gradiometer whole-head system (RICOH) in a shielded room at 1,000 Hz with a 200 Hz online low-pass filter. Stimuli were 20 Japanese newspaper articles presented word by word (500 ms word, 500 ms blank) with PsychoPy. Preprocessing used the CALM filter, ICA-based ocular artifact removal, 0.1–40 Hz bandpass filtering, epoching from -100 to 1000 ms, and downsampling to 200 Hz with MNE-Python and Eelbrain. T1-weighted images were defaced with PyDeface.
